subject: Sequenced cadence, canary & training sprint — implementation choreography for VectraAI
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Elise Turner <elise.turner@vectra.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sequenced cadence, canary & training sprint — implementation choreography for VectraAI

Hi Elise — great to be officially partnered. Per our signature last week, attached is a first-pass implementation choreography embedded in the Mutual Action Plan (MAP): a week-by-week sequence covering canary, migration, and training sprints plus the evaluation checkpoints you asked for.

Highlights: 
- Week 1 (canary prep & infra validation): staged canary lane + smoke tests.
- Week 2 (pilot traffic & model calibration): 10% traffic canary, eval suite run daily.
- Week 3 (migration waves): progressive cutover windows and rollback gates.
- Weeks 4–5 (training & enablement): admin & ops workshops + runbook handoff.

I've attached the MAP workbook and a separate canary checklist. Can we lock the pilot window (target week of July 7) and confirm participant availability for the training week?

Attachments: 20250611_MAP_v1.xlsx, canary-checklist.pdf

Best,
Chloe
Chloe Martin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Elise Turner <elise.turner@vectra.ai>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Jun 2025 09:18:24 -0700
Subject: Re: Sequenced cadence, canary & training sprint — implementation choreography for VectraAI

Thanks Chloe — saw the attachments and the week-by-week looks sensible. Quick clarifying questions: 
1) For the 10% traffic canary, can you confirm how we parallel the legacy endpoint? We need a zero-risk path for our payment flows.
2) For training, prefer a 2-day admin deep-dive and two 1-hour ops refreshers rather than a single 5-day block — can you update the plan?

I'll loop Jonah (ops) on availability for July.

Thanks,
Elise
Elise Turner
Head of Platform Ops, VectraAI
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 11:07:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Sequenced cadence, canary & training sprint — implementation choreography for VectraAI

Chloe / team — quick notes after I reviewed the MAP: 
- Canary approach: we recommend traffic-splitting at the gateway with header-based routing (X-Canary) to mirror payment flows; this avoids touching the legacy endpoint and gives us a toggled rollback.
- Health gates: add a KPIs matrix (error rate, p99 latency, payment success rate) with automated abort rules in the checklist.
- Eval cadence: run the scripted eval set (attached in the Drive link) nightly during the pilot and produce a summarized regression report each morning.

I'll update the canary-checklist to add the KPIs and the automation hooks. Priyom — can you confirm enablement materials (two-day admin + two 1-hour ops) map to our trainer availability?

-Vivek
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Elise Turner <elise.turner@vectra.ai>, Jonah Reed <jonah.reed@vectra.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Jun 2025 08:33:00 -0700
Subject: Finalized MAP + sprint cadence (updated per ops ask)

Elise / Jonah — attaching v2 of the MAP and a revised training outline per your preference. Key updates: 
- Canary implementation: header-based traffic split; legacy endpoint untouched. Rollback trigger: >0.5% payment error or p99 latency delta >300ms for two consecutive 5-min windows.
- Eval checkpoints: nightly regression suite, morning summary e-mail, and a canary dashboard with annotated gates.
- Training: 2-day admin deep-dive (Day 1: architecture & config; Day 2: runbook & incident drills) + two 60-minute ops refreshers during hypercare.
- Migration windows: two 2-hour cutover windows in Week 3 (early and late) with automated rollback procedure and post-cutover acceptance checklist.

Attachments: 20250611_MAP_v1.xlsx (updated), canary-checklist.pdf (updated), training-modules-outline.docx
Drive link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2B3cMAPDraft

Next steps: 
1) Please confirm pilot week (we still propose week of 2025-07-07).
2) Confirm attendees for the admin deep-dive (max 12 seats).
3) HubSpot: I will attach the finalized MAP to the deal record after your sign-off.

If everything looks good I'll schedule the first pre-canary sync with engineering for June 24.

Thanks — Chloe
From: Jonah Reed <jonah.reed@vectra.ai>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>, Elise Turner <elise.turner@vectra.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 14:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Finalized MAP + sprint cadence (updated per ops ask)

Chloe — thanks for the updates. Confirming: week of 2025-07-07 for pilot works for our ops team. We'll provide a list of 8 attendees for the admin deep-dive by EOD Friday. 

Two quick asks: 
- Can the nightly regression report include a brief callout for any model output drift observed (we have a compliance requirement to log anomalies)?
- Please include the HubSpot link to the final MAP in the deal record when you upload.

I'll be on the June 24 pre-canary sync.

Jonah
Ops Manager, VectraAI
